sections.content: Print stylesheets adapt web pages for paper: @page sets margins/size, @media print hides navigation, expands content, forces light colors, and prevents elements splitting across pages.
Use physical units (cm, mm, pt) for print, page-break-inside: avoid on cards/tables, and link rel=stylesheet media="print" for dedicated print CSS.
Key points: browsers strip backgrounds by default (print-color-adjust), links need url() text appended, and always preview before shipping.
